description: This file defines the 'MyMain' Activity for an Android application, including UI setup, admin management, and device wiping functionality.

classes.name: MyMain
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages device admin status and can perform device wipe actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the UI when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from enabling admin and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: refreshUi
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on device admin status.

methods.name: onAddAsAdmin
methods.description: Handles the toggle of admin status when the user interacts with the button.

methods.name: enableAdmin
methods.description: Starts activity to request device admin privileges.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the app by launching MyMain activity.

methods.name: onWipeData
methods.description: Shows confirmation dialog to wipe device data.

methods.name: wipe
methods.description: Performs the device wipe via DevicePolicyManager.
